acceptanceCriteria: companionrelease and release-artifact-v0 leave the affected floor, or a recorded decision accepts them as floor members with the reason
corvint affected on an unrelated change no longer selects them (if split)
body: V1-0643 remainder (lane test-speed-1021k, PR #1463). companionrelease builds the real ./cmd/* binaries and git-archives the checkout HEAD; release-artifact-v0 calls os.Getwd in non-test code and its PUB-V0-021 host proof needs the clean checkout. A read-scope entry cannot name .git, and partial fixtures do not take either package off the affected floor. Either move the real-checkout proofs into a dedicated package so the rest becomes hermetic, or record both as accepted floor members.
title: affected floor: split companionrelease and release-artifact-v0 real-checkout proofs into their own package (or accept them as floor members)
